plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's dreams. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking press against your imagination, hope, and idealism. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The quiet damage is in how you dismiss each other. One of you asks for proof of something that cannot be proven and makes the other feel doubted. The other treats plain logic as too small, too literal, a failure to feel, and makes the first one feel shut out. Neither of you usually means to. Both of you end up feeling unseen in exactly the place you most wanted to be understood. The shadow takes over when you fall in love with the feeling of the conversation and stop asking whether it is true. You read between the lines until the lines disappear. You decide this person wants what you want, means what you mean, sees what you see. Then the fog clears, reality arrives, and the disappointment can be brutal. There is a particular pain in realizing you were partly talking to your own dream.
advice: Keep returning to the shore. Come back to what was actually said, not what you hoped was meant.
summaryShort: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking press against your imagination, hope, and idealism.
